_comment: Map each furniture 'kind' to a LOCAL SketchUp component (.skp) in raw/assets/. Paths are relative to THIS file. Copy to 'furniture_catalog.json'. Any unmapped/missing kind falls back to a primitive box, so a PARTIAL catalog still works. Furniture is stored LOCALLY (not in R2).
_fields: file = .skp path. source/license = provenance (docs/LICENSING.md — only permissive licenses may ship; verify the friend's models actually originate where she thinks). fit = OPTIONAL: true SCALES the model to the spec footprint (use for inaccurate/AI models, e.g. FurniMesh); omit (default) places at the component's NATIVE size (correct for accurate components like the friend's own).
